about: The collecta of the formulary “Transfiguration of Our Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who in the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son strengthened the mysteries of faith by the testimony of the fathers, and, by the voice coming down in a shining cloud, miraculously betokened the complete adoption of Your children, mercifully grant that we be made co-heirs with that King of glory, and sharers in that same glory. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
